document.abstract: Experimental results and physical considerations are cited that should alleviate concerns about the freeze/thaw cycling of processed motion-picture film. Neither ice crystal formation nor high relative humidities are expected to occur under the recommended storage practices. No significant effects upon image stability or physical properties were observed in the experiments.
